name: ngx-rendering-service-api
description: Angular bindings for Edu-Sharing's rendering API

scripts.generate-api: npm run generate-api:generate-code && npm run generate-api:prettify-code && cp build/openapi.json src/lib/api/openapi.json
scripts.generate-api-if-needed: (test -d src/lib/api && cmp -s build/openapi.json src/lib/api/openapi.json) || npm run generate-api
scripts.publish: npm run build && cd dist && npm publish
